bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: A 100-car freight train weighing 14,000 tons traveling at 55 miles per hour requires more than 5,280 feet to stop under full emergency brake.
core_mechanism_bullets: A 100-car freight train weighing 14,000 tons traveling at 55 miles per hour requires more than 5,280 feet to stop under full emergency brake.
Standard North American track gauge measures 4 feet 8.5 inches between rail inner faces, supporting 286,000-pound gross rail car loads.
